requirements.label: tracks
requirements.title: Requirements for the Minor in Physics (by major college)

rule.manualCheck: Use the first track for students whose major is in the College of Arts and Sciences and the second track for students whose major is in the College of Engineering and Applied Sciences.

requirements.sourceText: Requirements for the Minor in Physics for students with majors in the College of Arts and Sciences: PHY 251 - Modern Physics; PHY 252 - Modern Physics Laboratory; PHY 300 - Waves and Optics; PHY 301 - Electromagnetic Theory I; PHY 303 - Mechanics; PHY 335 - Electronics and Instrumentation Laboratory; and one of the following: PHY 306 - Thermodynamics, Kinetic Theory, and Statistical Mechanics OR CHE 302 - Physical Chemistry II. Requirements for the Minor in Physics for students with majors in the College of Engineering and Applied Sciences: the following two courses: PHY 300 - Waves and Optics; PHY 303 - Mechanics; one of the following: PHY 251 - Modern Physics AND PHY 252 - Modern Physics Laboratory OR ESG 281 - Engineering Introduction to the Solid State; one of the following: PHY 301 - Electromagnetic Theory I OR ESE 319 - Electromagnetic Waves and Transmission Lines; one of the following: PHY 306 - Thermodynamics, Kinetic Theory, and Statistical Mechanics OR MEC 398 - Thermodynamics II OR CME 314 - Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics II; one of the following: PHY 335 - Electronics and Instrumentation Laboratory OR ESE 314 - Electronics Laboratory B
